name: prism-d1
description: PRISM's dashboard in the editor: the same pages and actions as prism-cli dashboard, plus codewatch findings in the Problems panel and the status bar. Works in VS Code, Kiro and Cursor. Needs prism-cli 1.21.0 or later.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: PRISM runs prism-cli in the workspace's repository, so it is off in untrusted folders.

commands.title: Copy finding as a fix prompt

prism.cliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `prism-cli` executable. Empty: found on `PATH`, then in per-user install folders (nvm, Volta, `~/.local/bin`, `~/.npm-global/bin`, the npm prefix). If it is still not found, set this to the output of `command -v prism-cli`. Machine-scoped, so a workspace's settings cannot change it.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm --prefix test/e2e ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && node test/e2e/run.mjs
